title.description: Names the job in a few words, so the buyer picks it out of their list.

narrative.description: Writes what a good buy looks like for THIS buyer, in their own terms — what they are after, what it has to do for them, and what would make it a bad buy. It is the spec of the job, so a want no keyed spec can carry stays here and still counts.

domain.description: Names the domain the specs below sit under: a domain path for product specs, `seller` for the seller specs, which belong to the whole brief.

key.description: Names the key from the domain read; `price` is a key every domain has.

op.description: Sends the operator the domain read listed for this key.

value.description: Sends the desired value, typed by the key's type.

currency.description: Required on money: sil holds no exchange rate, so the bound is tested against offers in this currency only, and `eur` matches no offer sil stores.

reason.description: Quotes the buyer's own words behind the spec, verbatim — never a paraphrase, never a sentence they did not say; a spec the guide derives from a measurement quotes the measurement. Reads them back before proposing to relax it.

specs.description: Writes the wants it can already express, keyed and typed by the domain read.
